name: Quattro
description: The Audi Quattro (1980–1991) — the Ur-Quattro — is the car that invented performance AWD for road cars and revolutionised rallying. Its permanent four-wheel drive system, derived from a military vehicle project, won the World Rally Championship in 1982 and 1984 with Hannu Mikkola and Stig Blomqvist, and permanently changed how performance cars handle.

generations.description: The Ur-Quattro (1980–1991) pioneered permanent four-wheel drive in a performance road car, winning the WRC in 1982 and 1984 and establishing the quattro drivetrain philosophy.
